# Probe job 4: does nsys capture only the range between cuProfilerStart and cuProfilerStop, for CUDA.jl and for JAX (through ctypes)? Prints one JSON line.
function sh(cmd; n = 2500)
    try
        s = strip(read(pipeline(ignorestatus(`bash -lc $cmd`); stderr = stdout), String))
        length(s) > n ? "... " * last(s, n) : s
    catch e
        "ERROR " * first(string(e), 200)
    end
end
esc(s) = replace(replace(replace(replace(s, "\\" => "\\\\"), "\"" => "\\\""), "\n" => "\\n"), r"[\x00-\x1f\x7f]" => " ")
out = Pair{String,String}[]
add(k, v) = push!(out, k => v)
d = mktempdir()
write(joinpath(d, "tiny.jl"), """
using CUDA
function k!(y, x)
    i = (blockIdx().x - 1) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x
    if i <= length(x); y[i] = 2.0 * x[i] + 1.0; end
    return nothing
end
x = CUDA.rand(Float64, 1_000_000); y = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1_000_000)
for _ in 1:2; @cuda threads = 256 blocks = cld(1_000_000, 256) k!(y, x); CUDA.synchronize(); end
CUDA.Profile.start()
for _ in 1:3; @cuda threads = 256 blocks = cld(1_000_000, 256) k!(y, x); CUDA.synchronize(); end
CUDA.Profile.stop()
for _ in 1:2; @cuda threads = 256 blocks = cld(1_000_000, 256) k!(y, x); CUDA.synchronize(); end
println("TINY OK")
""")
write(joinpath(d, "tiny.py"), """
import ctypes, jax, jax.numpy as jnp
cu = ctypes.CDLL("libcuda.so.1")
f = jax.jit(lambda x: jnp.sin(x) * 2.0 + 1.0)
x = jnp.ones(1_000_000)
for _ in range(2): f(x).block_until_ready()
print("start", cu.cuProfilerStart())
for _ in range(3): f(x).block_until_ready()
print("stop", cu.cuProfilerStop())
for _ in range(2): f(x).block_until_ready()
print("TINY PY OK")
""")
jl = joinpath(Sys.BINDIR, "julia")
st = "nsys stats --report cuda_gpu_kern_sum --format csv prof.nsys-rep 2>&1 | grep -v '^Generating\\|^Processing' | cut -c1-200 | head -8"
add("julia_capture", sh("cd $d && timeout 400 nsys profile --trace=cuda --sample=none --cpuctxsw=none --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi --capture-range-end=stop -o prof --force-overwrite true $jl --startup-file=no tiny.jl 2>&1 | tail -3; $st"))
add("jax_capture", sh("""cd $d && for f in /usr/share/Modules/init/bash /etc/profile.d/modules.sh; do [ -f "\$f" ] && { source "\$f"; break; }; done; module load python/anaconda3.12.7; export XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false; source \$WORK/stade_fw_venv/bin/activate; timeout 400 env -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH nsys profile --trace=cuda --sample=none --cpuctxsw=none --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi --capture-range-end=stop -o prof --force-overwrite true python tiny.py 2>&1 | tail -4; $st"""))
